cohort: 200 primiparous women (vaginal delivery and elective caesarean section groups)
finding: The mode of delivery had no significant effect on overall female sexual function 12 weeks after childbirth, although vaginal delivery was associated with decreased desire, arousal, and lubrication, while elective caesarean section was associated with decreased desire.
